The '''Ackbar family''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] family originating from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> The first known member of the family is [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>. The family had members who were part of the [[New Jedi Order]]<ref name="Dark Apprentice">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" /> The family's known members include:

*[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Jesmin Ackbar]], niece of Ackbar and cousin of Cilghal, [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the NRDF<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />
*[[Cilghal]], niece of Ackbar and cousin of Jesmin, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]]<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>

{{Family-stub}}
